text:
Abstract
This report answers a single query: how many ciprofloxacin studies (Dataset records) exist for Escherichia coli in the NIAID Data Ecosystem (NDE) federated index. I queried the NDE using two API calls: a targeted dataset search restricted to pathogen = "Escherichia coli" and a facet/count query for "infectiousAgent.name" over all ciprofloxacin Dataset records. Filters: free-text "ciprofloxacin", record_type = Dataset, and pathogen when specified. Key numbers: 391 Dataset records were returned for Escherichia coli; 2,607 total Dataset records matched "ciprofloxacin" across pathogens; 1,370 of those 2,607 had an infectiousAgent.name field populated; 391 is the facet count for the exact infectiousAgent.name value "escherichia coli". The 391 count therefore represents NDE Dataset records that match both the ciprofloxacin free-text term and an infectiousAgent.name mapped to Escherichia coli. This result matters for researchers planning literature/data surveys or meta-analyses because it quantifies the scale of ciprofloxacin-related datasets for E. coli in a broad federated index and informs subsequent steps (de-duplication, repository-specific checks, and access).

I. Introduction
Background. Ciprofloxacin is a fluoroquinolone antibiotic often studied in relation to Escherichia coli for susceptibility, resistance mechanisms, pharmacodynamics, and clinical outcomes. Knowing how many datasets exist in large federated indexes helps prioritize systematic data retrieval and meta-analysis planning.

Literature Review. No literature was retrieved for this query.

Knowledge Gap. Before querying, it was unclear how many ciprofloxacin-related Dataset records in the NDE specifically annotate Escherichia coli as the infectious agent.

Objective & Hypothesis. Objective: Count NDE Dataset records for "ciprofloxacin" that annotate Escherichia coli as the infectious agent. Hypothesis: The NDE index contains hundreds of ciprofloxacin datasets for E. coli (testable expectation: count > 100).

II. Materials and Methods
Study Design. I used the NDE (NIAID Data Ecosystem) programmatic API to (1) perform a targeted search constrained to Escherichia coli datasets matching "ciprofloxacin" and (2) compute facet counts of infectiousAgent.name across all ciprofloxacin Dataset records to confirm the E. coli share and the overall ciprofloxacin dataset counts. This combination tests both a direct-filtered query and the broader landscape.

Materials. Databases queried and tools used:
- NDE via nde_search_datasets (functions.nde_search_datasets)
- NDE facet/count via nde_facet_counts (functions.nde_facet_counts)

Procedures. Tool calls (order and exact arguments):
1) nde_search_datasets with parameters:
   - query: "ciprofloxacin"
   - pathogen: "Escherichia coli"
   - record_type: "Dataset"
   - size: 1
   (This returned a representative record and a total for the constrained query.)
   Provenance field in the returned JSON: "api_call": 
   https://api.data.niaid.nih.gov/v1/query?q=ciprofloxacin+AND+%40type%3A%22Dataset%22+AND+infectiousAgent.name%3A%22Escherichia+coli%22&size=1&_source=_id%2C%40type%2Cname%2Cdescription%2Curl%2Cdoi%2Cidentifier%2Cdate%2CdatePublished%2CdateModified%2CincludedInDataCatalog.name%2CincludedInDataCatalog.url%2CincludedInDataCatalog.archivedAt%2Cauthor.name%2CinfectiousAgent.name%2CinfectiousAgent.displayName%2Cspecies.name%2ChealthCondition.name%2CmeasurementTechnique.name%2CtopicCategory.name%2Ckeywords%2CconditionsOfAccess%2Clicense%2Cdistribution.contentUrl%2CsourceOrganization.name%2Cfunding.funder.name%2CprogrammingLanguage%2CapplicationCategory%2CoperatingSystem%2CsoftwareVersion%2CcodeRepository%2CisBasedOn.identifier%2CvariableMeasured.name%2Cvalue%2CunitText%2CmarginOfError.name%2CmarginOfError.value%2CobservationAbout.name%2CobservationAbout.identifier%2CmeasuredProperty.name%2CobservationType.name%2CmeasurementQualifier%2CsubjectOf.identifier

2) nde_facet_counts with parameters:
   - fields: "infectiousAgent.name"
   - query: "ciprofloxacin"
   - record_type: "Dataset"
   - top_n: 20
   (This returned total matching records for the ciprofloxacin Dataset query and the facet counts by infectiousAgent.name.)
   Provenance field in the returned JSON: 
   https://api.data.niaid.nih.gov/v1/query?q=ciprofloxacin+AND+%40type%3A%22Dataset%22&size=0&facets=infectiousAgent.name&facet_size=20

Statistical Analysis. Counts were read directly from the NDE API JSON fields:
- Escherichia coli count = facet value "escherichia coli" count (391).
- Total ciprofloxacin Dataset matches = matching_records (2,607).
- Number of ciprofloxacin Dataset records with infectiousAgent.name populated = total_with_field (1,370).
Percent calculation: proportion of ciprofloxacin datasets annotated as Escherichia coli = 391 / 2,607 = 0.14988 (15.0%). No deduplication across repositories was performed; each NDE Dataset record was counted once as indexed. All percentages use 2,607 as denominator unless noted; when reporting proportions conditioned on records that had infectiousAgent.name populated, the denominator would be 1,370 (not used for the main percentage above but noted here as a methodological caveat).

III. Results
Data Presentation.

Table 1. Counts from NDE queries
| Metric | Value |
|---|---:|
| Total NDE Dataset records matching "ciprofloxacin" (all pathogens) | 2,607 |
| NDE Dataset records (of those) with infectiousAgent.name populated | 1,370 |
| NDE Dataset records with infectiousAgent.name = "escherichia coli" | 391 |
| Proportion of ciprofloxacin datasets annotated as E. coli (391/2607) | 0.14988 (15.0%) |

Findings. The NDE index contains 2,607 Dataset records matching the free-text term "ciprofloxacin". Among those, 1,370 had the infectiousAgent.name field populated. The facet count for infectiousAgent.name = "escherichia coli" is 391. The proportion of ciprofloxacin datasets annotated as E. coli is 15.0% when using the full ciprofloxacin Dataset set (391 / 2,607).

IV. Discussion
Interpretation. The main result (391) directly answers the objective: the NDE index currently lists 391 Dataset records that match "ciprofloxacin" and annotate Escherichia coli as the infectious agent. This number represents indexed datasets across multiple underlying repositories (e.g., Figshare and others) as aggregated by the NDE.

Context. The direct search restricted to pathogen = Escherichia coli returned total = 391 (same number as the facet value), confirming internal consistency between the pathogen-filtered search and the facet breakdown. An example dataset returned in the pathogen-restricted search is hosted on Figshare (record: Phylogenetic group, ciprofloxacin MICs, …; record URL provided in References).

Limitations. The NDE index can include duplicate or overlapping Dataset records across repositories; no de-duplication by DOI or content was performed here. The match is based on free-text "ciprofloxacin" and the infectiousAgent.name controlled field; records without infectiousAgent.name populated (941 of the ciprofloxacin matches) were not attributed to any pathogen in the facet and therefore could include additional E. coli studies. The facet counts depend on how infectiousAgent.name values are normalized (case and variant spellings), and the returned facet value is lowercased ("escherichia coli"); near-duplicates (e.g., strain-specific or variant spellings) may be split or separately counted (some strain-specific values also appear in the facet list). The index snapshot reflects the time of the API response and can change as records are added or reindexed.

Conclusion & Future Directions. Takeaway: NDE currently indexes 391 ciprofloxacin Dataset records annotated to Escherichia coli. Next queries worth running: (1) request the full list of the 391 dataset identifiers (to enable de-duplication by DOI/identifier and selective downloading), (2) expand the search to include records lacking infectiousAgent.name (to capture additional E. coli-related datasets), and (3) filter by repository (e.g., NCBI SRA, Figshare) or date range for targeted retrieval.

References
[1] NIAID Data Ecosystem API call (pathogen-restricted search). Provenance URL returned by nde_search_datasets call:
https://api.data.niaid.nih.gov/v1/query?q=ciprofloxacin+AND+%40type%3A%22Dataset%22+AND+infectiousAgent.name%3A%22Escherichia+coli%22&size=1&_source=_id%2C%40type%2Cname%2Cdescription%2Curl%2Cdoi%2Cidentifier%2Cdate%2CdatePublished%2CdateModified%2CincludedInDataCatalog.name%2CincludedInDataCatalog.url%2CincludedInDataCatalog.archivedAt%2Cauthor.name%2CinfectiousAgent.name%2CinfectiousAgent.displayName%2Cspecies.name%2ChealthCondition.name%2CmeasurementTechnique.name%2CtopicCategory.name%2Ckeywords%2CconditionsOfAccess%2Clicense%2Cdistribution.contentUrl%2CsourceOrganization.name%2Cfunding.funder.name%2CprogrammingLanguage%2CapplicationCategory%2CoperatingSystem%2CsoftwareVersion%2CcodeRepository%2CisBasedOn.identifier%2CvariableMeasured.name%2Cvalue%2CunitText%2CmarginOfError.name%2CmarginOfError.value%2CobservationAbout.name%2CobservationAbout.identifier%2CmeasuredProperty.name%2CobservationType.name%2CmeasurementQualifier%2CsubjectOf.identifier

[2] NIAID Data Ecosystem API call (facet/count across ciprofloxacin Datasets). Provenance URL returned by nde_facet_counts call:
https://api.data.niaid.nih.gov/v1/query?q=ciprofloxacin+AND+%40type%3A%22Dataset%22&size=0&facets=infectiousAgent.name&facet_size=20

[3] Example dataset returned in the pathogen-restricted search (Figshare record). Record URL from the NDE result:
https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/Phylogenetic_group_ciprofloxacin_MICs_efflux_activity_PMQR_genes_and_QRDR_mutations_among_19_high_level_ciprofloxacin_resistant_E_coli_strains_/29201425

Acknowledgments
Data aggregated by the NIAID Data Ecosystem (NDE) and the Figshare repository (the example record) were used to produce these counts.
